failures.symptom: An all-engine-best self-play produced no review fact above the candidate threshold and timed out waiting for [data-evidence-id].
failures.cause: The generated game had no qualifying mistake; this was a test-data problem, not an analysis failure.
failures.correction: Limited safe, deliberately non-best high-exposure choices to plies 6-13 and reran the entire production scenario, producing a genuine 747 CPL blunder fact.
